from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs/task-8366902d.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def _trim(mask):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(mask) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    return [[int(mask[r][c]) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frame = grid[0][0]
    panel_w = next((c for c, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v == 0), w)
    left = [row[:panel_w] for row in grid]
    cuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(left) if all(v == frame for v in row)]

    objects = {}
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row[panel_w:] if v not in (0, frame)}
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(panel_w, w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
        objects[color] = _trim([[int(grid[r][c] == color) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)])

    for top, bottom in zip(cuts, cuts[1:]):
        mask = [[int(left[r][c] == 0) for c in range(panel_w)] for r in range(top + 1, bottom)]
        shape = _trim(mask)
        for color, obj in objects.items():
            if shape == obj:
                for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
                    for c in range(panel_w):
                        if left[r][c] == 0:
                            left[r][c] = color
                break
    return left
'''
p.write_text(code)
# Test demo and given input
